title: 5.1.1 Sprite Showcase — Example
description: A tour of what a sprite can look like: colors, shapes, sizes. Read the code, run it, change things.

steps.title: Run it
steps.instructions: Click Run. You'll see six sprites: rectangles, squares, circles, in different colors.
hints: Nothing moves yet — we'll add movement in the next lesson.

steps.title: Resize a sprite
steps.instructions: Change the width/height numbers in a `new Sprite(x, y, w, h)` call.
hints: `new Sprite(x, y, diameter)` with one size argument makes a circle collider.

steps.title: Restore to default
steps.instructions: Click History → File History → 'Original (starter)' → Restore to get the code back.
hints: This only appears on examples — feel free to experiment without fear.
